cd /workspace/tests && python3 - <<'PYEOF'
import sys, random, time, importlib.util
from array import array
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("submain", "/workspace/submission/main.py")
m = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(m)
def brute(items, full):
    items = [(mk & full, c, q) for mk,c,q in items]
    n=len(items); size=1<<n
    unions = array('I', bytes(4*size)); costs = array('H', bytes(2*size))
    best=None
    for mk in range(size):
        if mk:
            low=mk&-mk; i=low.bit_length()-1; prev=mk^low
            u=unions[prev]|items[i][0]; unions[mk]=u
            c=costs[prev]+items[i][1]; costs[mk]=c
        else: u=0;c=0
        if u==full:
            key=(c,mk.bit_count())
            if best is None or key<best: best=key
    return best
random.seed(555)
worst=0
for trial in range(300):
    npairs = random.randint(10, 28)
    n = random.randint(12, 20)
    items=[]
    for i in range(n):
        mask = random.getrandbits(npairs)
        if mask==0: mask = 1<<random.randrange(npairs)
        items.append((mask, random.randint(1,50), "q%02d"%i))
    cov=0
    for it in items: cov|=it[0]
    full=(1<<npairs)-1
    if cov!=full: continue
    t0=time.time(); sol=m._solve_cover(items, full, npairs); dt=time.time()-t0
    worst=max(worst,dt)
    b=brute(items, full)
    assert (sol[0],sol[1])==b, (trial, sol, b)
print("300 large instances OK, worst %.3fs" % worst)
PYEOF
